Description.Name: All Materials Gathered
Description.Details:
<color=#BFBFBF>Darius taps through a supply manifest as the last container gets logged into the hold.</color> "That's the last of it, Commander. Cable and data line, the conduit to run it all through, a solid stock of sensors and probes, and a full set of communications gear to tie the hangar together with the rest of the Argo."

<color=#BFBFBF>Yang leans over his shoulder, scanning the list.</color> "Everything we needed for the wiring and the eyes and ears of the place. Hangar's actually starting to look like it might work one day. We finally have everything needed to finish the job properly, just need the construction crew now."

Description.Name: Start the Search
Description.Details: You look over the manifest one last time and nod. "Good work, both of you. Get it all staged and ready to go." Farah gives a small nod and heads off to arrange the staging. Yang claps a hand on a nearby crate. "Just say the word once we got the construction crew hired, Commander. Time to finally get it all done." [The construction crew can be hired by remaining in port at a star system with the Manufacturing attribute. This may take some time to trigger.]
